summary.ja: 重複gatherとbroadcastを含む真の逆tapeを独立Jacobianと照合します。
summary.en: Check a genuine reverse tape, including repeated-index gather and broadcast, against independent Jacobians.

assumptions.ja: 小さな固定入力・実数・無次元。詳しい入力と適用範囲は対応する契約に限定します。
assumptions.en: Small fixed real dimensionless inputs; assumptions and scope are limited to the matching contract.

algorithm.ja: 逆topological順のcotangent加算と独立の前向き方向計算です。
algorithm.en: Accumulate cotangents in reverse topological order with a separate forward directional path.

validation.ja: 固定入力・独立参照・保存候補・全判定を同じ120秒予算内で検証します。数値合格と診断用非収束を区別します。
validation.en: Check fixed inputs, independent references, retained candidates and every gate within the same120-second budget. Numerical success and diagnostic nonconvergence are distinct.

limits.ja: 一般のNumPy/JAX置換や複素数ADではありません。
limits.en: Not a general NumPy/JAX replacement or complex AD system.

caption.ja: 独立矩形Jacobianと実際の逆微分誤差、固定wide写像の実測sweep数。
caption.en: Independent rectangular Jacobian, actual reverse differentiation error and measured sweep counts for fixed wide maps.

references.author: The JAX authors
references.title: The Autodiff Cookbook
references.review_scope: Selected definitions and composition formulas only. A new educational tape will implement the stated finite subset. No JAX installation, execution, timing replication or implementation-source audit. Unread: Original reverse-mode/HVP papers, JAX transformation implementation, Unselected cookbook sections. Publication year not established (n.d.).

references.author: The JAX authors
references.title: Frequently asked questions: undefined branches and ordering
references.review_scope: Read invalid inactive-branch and ordering discussions. We use an explicitly different strict nondifferentiability policy, not a universal JAX tie rule. Unread: Linked issue threads, Generalized derivative original papers. Publication year not established (n.d.).

editorial_note.ja: 一般のNumPy/JAX置換や複素数ADではありません。 図の座標は有限次元の変数・反復・診断で、物理空間の次元やPDE境界を表しません。
editorial_note.en: Not a general NumPy/JAX replacement or complex AD system. Plot axes describe finite-dimensional variables, iterations or diagnostics, not a physical spatial dimension or PDE boundary.

scope.ja: 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。
scope.en: These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems.
